entries.title: Event detail actions now stack vertically on narrower desktop widths to prevent clipped controls in rehearsal and concert headers.
Vote results popover now uses the shared person/contact row layout, fixing broken voter list rendering and improving readability on smaller screens.
Escalation minimums now support configurable combined instrument pairings with shared rehearsal and concert thresholds.
Escalation now sends a follow-up resolved email when an at-risk event returns to a healthy state, including immediate checks after participation or member assignment changes.
